title: From Varuni to bhang: How India’s ancient drinking traditions became a colonial tax machine
description: Throughout history, ancient Indian cultures embraced intoxicants such as toddy and cannabis, weaving them into the fabric of religious and martial practices. Under colonial rule, the British imposed taxes on distilled beverages while limiting local production to boost government revenue. In contrast, independence ushered in laws that prohibited traditional substances, disrupting long-standing community customs.

title: Fossil Bone Ring Rewrites Mammal Live Birth Timeline by 90 Million Years
description: Mammal live birth evolution fossil: a 236-million-year-old Argentine cynodont fossil contains a neonatal bone ring showing live birth in the mammalian lineage 90 million years earlier than any prior evidence -- a discovery that could mean the platypus represents a reversal from live birth back to egg-laying.
